title: Gift Card Claim Service Rate Schedule for Finch Circle Cardholders — Merchandise Purchases
content:
On a gift card claim for a Merchandise Purchases unit, the daily gift card service rate of a customer holding an active card in the Marlowe & Finch Credit Cards program follows the tier of the customer's active Finch Circle Loyalty Program membership:

| Active Finch Circle tier | Active Marlowe & Finch card | Daily gift card service rate |
|---|---|---|
| Gold, Platinum, Diamond or Icon | held | top rate, $0.60 per day |
| Member or Silver | held | base rate, $0.30 per day |

Both parts of a row must hold. A customer with no active membership, or with no active Marlowe & Finch card, is outside this schedule.

*Hypothetical:* a Platinum member holding an active Store Card receives $0.60 per day; a Silver member holding none is outside this schedule.
